zh: 这件任务超过 §0§ 秒没有动静，已经停掉：多半是哪一段代码里有死循环。
en: This job showed no progress for more than §0§ seconds and has been stopped: most likely some piece of code contains an infinite loop.

zh: 这个环境不允许创建后台线程，这件事做不了。
en: This environment does not allow background threads to be created, so this cannot be done.

zh: 这个浏览器开不了隔离环境，所以不运行别人写的代码。换一个新一点的浏览器再试。
en: This browser cannot start the isolated environment, so code written by other people is not run. Try again with a newer browser.
